structured_output.summary: This readiness attempt has real, complete evidence for the unchanged fingerprint f9cebee5: 105 commands, all exit 0, with no timeouts and no source changes. That includes both `--require-directional` clean-package runs (1.89.0 and 1.99.0, each executing the directional example and external consumer) and `check-access-release --phase 28 --version 0.2.4`. The SDK and release tooling are byte-identical to the source accepted in attempt 4, so implementation quality is unchanged. One new problem: the regenerated proofs and readiness receipt now qualify b40409e (archives c0bf52/cab742) rather than the published 6f18529/533294fe. With these files in place, `release_delivery.verify` (validate_receipts) could not pass for phase 28. Three different commits now carry 0.2.4 qualification. Attempt 4's governance medium (mirror push authorization not in AGENTS.md or PHASES.md) and its low (README link not bound by a test) are still open. Publishing before readiness passed is disclosed, not cured. Total 42/50, which clears the attempt-5 floor (>40, every category ≥8) only with these deficiencies recorded.

findings.description: The gate run regenerated the phase-28 clean-package proofs and the readiness receipt. They are now bound to releaseCommit b40409e and archive c0bf5219… (1.89.0: cab74247…). docs/checks/release-registry-0.2.4.json:11-14 records the published 6f18529 and 533294fe…. tools/release_delivery.py:86-88 requires registry sourceCommit and archiveSha256 to equal the 1.99.0 proof, so the in-tree phase-28 delivery verifier would now reject these files. Delivery is evidenced only through the separate historical-delivery copy and the phase-28-published-package proofs, which name yet another commit (424407a; phase-28-published-archive-comparison.json:15). Attempt 4's binding to the published commit (6f18529/533294fe) has been overwritten.
findings.required_fix: Pick one qualifying commit for 0.2.4. Either keep the phase-28-release-package-*.json and phase-28-release-readiness.json receipts bound to 6f18529/533294fe, or record in phase-status.json an explicit mapping (b40409e / 424407a / 6f18529 share the same fingerprint, and the packaged files are identical except .cargo_vcs_info.json). Also record that release_delivery.verify(28, '0.2.4') is not the delivery authority and say which verifier is.
